title: Vendor Access Handling
text: Program Coordinators may submit vendor access requests when external partners need temporary participation in a launch activity. The request must include vendor approval, access capacity, expected start date, and planned end date before manager review. If approval is missing or capacity is unavailable, the request must be returned to the coordinator with a clear reason. Approved access requests must notify the Access Manager and reserve capacity before activation.

title: Approval Packet Review
text: Approval packets require Finance Analyst review before purchase orders are released. The packet should include effort estimates, material needs, budget owner approval, and any missing-information notes. If required information is missing, the packet remains pending until the Program Coordinator resolves it. Approved packets record the decision date and approving role.
